forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for {email}, a reset link is on its way. It expires in 1 hour.
forgot.unavailable: Password recovery is not set up on this installation. Ask your administrator to configure email.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.doneBody: Sign in with your new password. Your other devices have been signed out.
reset.invalidBody: Reset links work once and expire after 1 hour. Request a new one to continue.
